title: Preload and retain a twelve-cell service pack
instruction: Fit all twelve cells with the polarity shown at each bay. Compress the blue pressure plate over the cells, slide the orange capture key through both retaining channels, then release both hands.
context: The contribution is compressing twelve independent contact springs with a plate and transferring their load to a cross-key while preserving cell polarity. Cell count provides sustained progress but is not the novelty argument.
